scope: Apparatus and measurement diagrams beside practical methods; shared artwork reused in the practical-skills chapter.

placements.heading: Preparing a pure dry soluble salt
placements.purpose: Filter excess insoluble solid, collect the salt solution, then concentrate it in an evaporating basin over a water bath and cool to crystallise.

placements.heading: Temperature changes in reacting solutions
placements.purpose: A supported insulated cup has a loose lid, thermometer bulb in the liquid and a stirrer.

placements.heading: Concentration and rate: turbidity or colour
placements.diagram: Chemistry - AQA/06 - Rate and extent of chemical change/Diagrams/disappearing-cross-practical.svg
placements.purpose: Viewed from above, a cross under the flask becomes hidden as sulfur makes the liquid cloudy. Keep the viewing depth constant.

placements.heading: Paper chromatography
placements.purpose: Paper hangs in a covered vessel. The pencil baseline and sample spots are above the solvent; the solvent front is marked higher up the paper.

placements.heading: Identifying unknown ionic compounds
placements.purpose: A clean wire loop holds a sample in the blue non-luminous flame of a Bunsen burner.
